name: expo-touch-passthrough
description: A native view that lets touches fall through to whatever is behind it (other UIKit windows included) outside a configurable set of still-interactive child rects. Exists because RN's <Modal> presents in its own UIViewController whose root content view has no pointerEvents concept of its own — a tap that RN's own box-none/none views correctly decline still lands on that bare root view and never reaches the window underneath.
author: Televo
